name: chapter-news
description: Chapter News, phase 5 of prds/home-page-plan.md (§ 6.4; rulings 4 to 6): CChapterNews, one news item, and CChapterNewsReceipt, one member's Dismissed or Acknowledged on one item. Audience is a multi-select of the CRM's team names (audienceTeams), not a link: EspoCRM refuses a link to Team, which is not customizable (LinkManager, read on the Association 11-20-26). The build script fills audienceTeams' options from the CRM's teams. Additive only. No field Read-only: the application writes them all (ruling 40). Handoff: cchapternews-entities-crm-handoff.md. Built by scripts/migrate_chapter_news_schema.py, never by apply_crm_plan.py alone (it fills the team options).

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Summary
fields.tooltipText: Shown on the home page before the item is opened, and in the weekly digest.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Body
fields.tooltipText: The full item: formatted text and images.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.tooltipText: Only Published items reach members. A Withdrawn item disappears for everyone, past news included.

fields.name: publishAt
fields.label: Publish at
fields.tooltipText: A Published item reaches members from this time.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.label: Expires at
fields.tooltipText: Optional. The item leaves the home page and the digest at this time and stays in past news.

fields.name: audienceTeams
fields.label: Audience teams
fields.tooltipText: The teams the item is for. Empty means every member. The options are the CRM's team names, kept in step by scripts/migrate_chapter_news_schema.py.

fields.name: ctaLabel
fields.label: Button text
fields.tooltipText: Optional call to action: the button's words.

fields.name: ctaUrl
fields.label: Button address
fields.tooltipText: Optional call to action: where the button goes.
